propositions: The completion verifier returns contradictory verdicts (PASS/FAIL) for identical inputs across multiple runs with no intervening code changes.
The verifier's false-FAIL (spurious unmet criteria) blocks completion of legitimate tickets and wastes billable LLM calls on retries.

Test-existence verification is unreliable due to the agent using free-form search strategies that fallback to literal substring or regex queries instead of systematic ticket-id and symbol-based enumeration.
The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar payload lacks verified_at_sha and trace_id fields, preventing diagnosability of whether apparent non-determinism reflects input drift or genuine sampling variance.
Temperature is unpinned during verifier execution, allowing sampling variance to flip borderline test-existence judgments between passes.
